consequences: A normal future pip install malleus includes the compiler and LinkML.
A lean installation remains deferred to a later governed revision if a concrete need earns it.
constraints: Introduce no core or compiler extra, second distribution, or external compiler package in v0.
The artifact-backed runtime remains semantically LinkML-free and must pass with LinkML imports blocked even when LinkML is installed; make no current packaging claim.
data.selected_option: One distribution with compiler and LinkML in the normal installation

summary: Accept one future distribution including compiler and LinkML.
why: The one-distribution topology is the smallest normal installation contract. Runtime neutrality is enforced at the artifact and import boundary rather than by delaying progress for an unused lean packaging topology.
